verdict.rationale: Foreloop's gate is a human approving a task contract before an agent starts work, not a review of the actual code diff before it becomes a pull request (docs-3, docs-7, docs-37). Once approved, the agent works autonomously and opens the PR itself; review of the actual diff happens only afterward via automated PR checks (docs-22, docs-23, docs-24), not human diff approval pre-PR. Missing for 10: evidence of a human viewing the concrete code diff and explicitly approving it before the PR is created.
